summary: The Acer Aspire 7 Gaming is a budget-friendly gaming laptop experiencing thermal throttling and occasional BSOD due to driver issues. It has Intel Core i5-8305G, NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650, 8GB DDR4 RAM, and 256GB NVMe SSD.
detected_fault: Thermal throttling and BSOD due to driver issues
suggested_solution: Update drivers, consider upgrading cooling system or adding more RAM
